about_meta: An accounting practice with branches in Ashdod and Rishon LeZion, serving companies, self-employed professionals, nonprofits, and individuals.
about_title: Getting to know your business is part of our work.
about_intro: Myri Dekel CPA provides accounting services and ongoing support to companies, self-employed professionals, nonprofits, and individuals—with a personal, organized, and clear approach.
about_view_title: From routine reporting to your next decision.
about_p1: We support clients with opening tax files, ongoing accounting, regulatory reporting, tax planning, annual returns, and capital declarations.
about_p2: We begin by understanding the structure of your business, your needs, and the questions in front of you. From there, we set priorities and explain what is required, when, and why.
about_p3: The goal is to give you a consistent professional point of contact—one that organizes the details, speaks plainly, and remains available as your business or circumstances change.
about_values_title: Guidance that fits the way you operate.
about_client_businesses_desc: Ongoing accounting, regulatory reporting, and tax planning for limited companies and businesses.
about_client_self_employed_desc: Opening tax files and ongoing support for VAT-registered and exempt self-employed businesses.
about_client_organizations_desc: Accounting services for nonprofits, along with annual returns and capital declarations for individuals.
about_locations_intro: The practice has two branches, in Ashdod and Rishon LeZion. Choose the location that is most convenient when you get in touch.
about_locations_note: Contact us for the exact address and to arrange a meeting at the appropriate branch.
